description.value: Tatawaw Kanata Glamping & Wellness is an adult-only glamping retreat on the traditional unceded territory of the Syilx Okanagan peoples near Vernon, BC, offering hard-wall rustic tents with private patios, fire-pits, and en-suite two-piece bathrooms. The property weaves Indigenous cultural experiences into the stay, with opportunities to meet band knowledge keepers and elders. Guests can use a communal cook shed, outdoor socializing areas, and optional third-party wellness and guided adventure bookings throughout the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real glamping business near Vernon, BC, on Syilx Okanagan territory, with its inaugural season beginning spring 2026; as of late June 2026 it should be in its operating window. The site explicitly mentions Wi-Fi, outdoor shower, 3-piece bathroom suite trailers (shower/sink/toilet), communal dining/cook shed, and a 'Book Now' booking system, providing direct evidence for several amenities. No phone or street address appears in OSM or on the website; the OSM name differs slightly from the website's preferred 'TK Glamping & Wellness' branding.
concerns: OSM name 'Tatawaw Kanata Glamping & Wellness' differs from website's consistent branding as 'TK Glamping & Wellness' / 'TK Glamping and Wellness in Vernon BC'.
No street address available in OSM or on the website; only Vernon, BC and a reference to 'Head of the Lake' site location.
No phone number in OSM or on the website (only email info@tkglamping.com found in page footer).
Business is in its inaugural operating year (spring 2026); limited operational track record.
Adult-only and no-pets policy may limit accessibility for some cycling groups.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating glamping business with a functioning website and booking system in the Vernon/North Okanagan area; its inaugural season started spring 2026 and it is currently in its summer operating window.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email info@tkglamping.com found in website footer. Property is described as located on a wildlife corridor near the 'Head of the Lake' area on Syilx Okanagan traditional territory.
